title: Nominatim Geo-coding — geocode
text: Get GPS coordinates addresses using OpenStreetMap Nominatim API.

title: Nominatim Geo-coding — geocode
code: geocode(   x,   cache = Sys.getenv("R_KMAPS_CACHE"),   timeout = 8760,   limit = 1,   verbose = FALSE )

title: Nominatim Geo-coding — geocode
text: x character vector addresses. cache path cache folder (see details). timeout numeric (hours) cache data obsolete. limit numeric (Mb) define cache size limit. verbose logical logs printed console.

title: Nominatim Geo-coding — geocode
text: Wrapping calls Nominatim API cache system mandatory avoid IP banning (many requests send query). cache timeout set 1 year (8760 hours) limit 1 Mb. Also encryption activated since API returns open data. Use R_KMAPS_CACHE environment variable define .

title: Nominatim Geo-coding — geocode
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # assuming R_KMAPS_CACHE environment variable has been set geocode("Musée du Louvre") geocode(c("Musée du Louvre", "Musée d'Orsay")) } # }

title: Nominatim Reverse Geo-coding — rev_geocode
text: Get addresses GPS coordinates using OpenStreetMap Nominatim API.

title: Nominatim Reverse Geo-coding — rev_geocode
code: rev_geocode(   lng,   lat,   zoom = 18,   addressdetails = 1,   cache = Sys.getenv("R_KMAPS_CACHE"),   timeout = 8760,   limit = 1,   verbose = FALSE )

title: Nominatim Reverse Geo-coding — rev_geocode
text: lng numeric vector longitude. lat numeric vector latitude. zoom numeric value passed Nominatim API (see details). addressdetails numeric value passed Nominatim API (see details). cache path cache folder (see details). timeout numeric (hours) cache data obsolete. limit numeric (Mb) define cache size limit. verbose logical logs printed console.
